diagnosis: The compliance scan report endpoint invokes a binary runner using child_process.execFile with req.params.scanId directly from the request path. It does not verify that the scan job was executed on infrastructure owned by the caller's organization. Attackers can view security vulnerability reports, unpatched CVEs, and compliance failures of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/compliance/scans/scan_infra_corp_88194/report HTTP/1.1
Host: security.saas.internal:4042
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_dev_token>
Accept: application/json
